description: A user's mind maps. The document; its nodes are table 35. Import THIRTY-FOURTH
notes: board is TEXT holding either the literal 'personal' or a user_projects ROW id - the same shape as project_id on user_tasks and board on inspiration_items. A map is therefore either a standalone idea map or part of a project, and moving it between the two is one column write.
Users live in Xano, so user_id is TEXT holding String(user.id). EVERY read filters on it.
node_count is denormalised so /maps can show how big a map is without loading every node. The client writes it; it is a display hint, never a source of truth.
There is no layout column. Node positions are COMPUTED from the tree every render (config/mind-map-layout.ts) and never stored - that is what keeps a map tidy without the user tidying it.
theme names a colour set in the client. Unknown values fall back to the default rather than failing.
